definitions.gloss: lapis lazuli blue; deep azure; ultramarine blue
definitions.explanation: A vivid, deep blue color reminiscent of the gemstone lapis lazuli. One of Japan's traditional color names, evoking a rich, jewel-like blue.

examples.japanese: {瑠璃色|るりいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっていた→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: A deep azure sky stretched out before us.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{瑠璃色|るりいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{輝|かがや}いていた→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧。
examples.english: The sea was shining in a deep lapis blue.

examples.japanese: {瑠璃色|るりいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ガラス→ガラス：01777_garasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{器|うつわ}→器：11838_utsuwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{土産|みやげ}→お土産：01353_omiyage⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a lapis blue glass vessel as a souvenir.

notes:
Composed of {瑠璃|るり} (lapis lazuli, a precious blue stone) and ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧ (color). One of Japan's traditional color names ({伝統色|でんとうしょく}), carrying a sense of elegance and depth that plain "blue" does not convey. Frequently used in literary and poetic descriptions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {瑠璃色|るりいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧: deep blue sky
- {瑠璃色|るりいろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧: deep blue sea
- {瑠璃色|るりいろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{光|ひか}る→光る：01163_hikaru⟧: to gleam in lapis blue

CULTURAL NOTE:
{瑠璃|るり} is one of the Seven Treasures ({七宝|しっぽう}) in Buddhism, and the color has spiritual associations. The {瑠璃光|るりこう}{如来|にょらい} (Medicine Buddha) is associated with this color. The Japanese bird オオルリ (blue-and-white flycatcher) also takes its name from this color.

SIMILAR COLORS:
- ⟦{藍色|あいいろ}→藍色：15519_aiiro⟧: indigo — darker and greener
- ⟦{紺色|こんいろ}→紺色：13792_koniro⟧: navy blue — darker and more subdued
- ⟦{群青色|ぐんじょういろ}→群青色：20488_gunjouiro⟧: ultramarine — very similar, also derived from mineral pigments
- ⟦{青色|あおいろ}→青色：22937_aoiro⟧: blue — the general color name
